files.README.md:
# Sallowbeck Grain Store - intake and drying

Shared folder for the weighbridge office.

- bins/  cards for each bin and drying batch
- haulage/  tickets from the carters

turns.prompt: A trader new to Sallowbeck Grain Store asked what is meant by shrinkage on a bin card; drying takes off water only, so the weight at the target moisture is the weighed weight times one minus the intake moisture over one minus the target moisture. Bin B-56 weighed 42.5 tonnes at 20 percent moisture and is being taken down to 15 percent. Give the weight the bin holds once it is down to target in tonnes.
